paths.description: Entry page and mandatory age/consent gate at desktop, representing first-visit access to the site.
First-visit age gate at 360px, representing narrow mobile access and reflow.
Videos listing route selected from primary navigation; it redirected to the gated homepage in a fresh session.
Representative video detail/player page discovered from homepage links; metadata, headings, controls and caption tracks inspected beneath the gate.
Category/index archetype selected from primary navigation; it redirected to the gated homepage in a fresh session.
A deliberately unknown route was requested to inspect failure/recovery behavior; it returned HTTP 200 and the homepage.

findings.summary: The mandatory age gate is fixed at desktop width and clipped on a 360px viewport.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshot shows the logo, heading, legal text, second age choice and footer cut off to the right. Layout metrics report no document overflow only because html/body are fixed to the viewport, so the clipped fixed-width panel cannot be reached by horizontal scrolling.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the gate panel inline-size: min(100% - 2rem, 780px), remove fixed 780px body/html sizing, stack both age choices at narrow widths, and verify 320px reflow.

findings.summary: First-visit loading is slow and visually unstable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 13.1s and CLS 0.626 (performance 0.43). HAR captured 170 requests and 5,408,745 transferred bytes; Lighthouse reports 178 KiB unused JS and 74 KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the actual LCP resource, reserve space for late content, defer non-critical scripts/styles and ads, and remove unused bundles before the age gate becomes interactive.

findings.summary: Accessible names, structure, focus, scaling and media alternatives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, frame-title, label-content-name-mismatch and meta-viewport. The platform probe found no main/nav landmarks, no h1 on the entry page, three unnamed controls and no visible outline on the first focused link. The video detail exposed no caption tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every control/frame, add semantic landmarks and a logical h1, restore a strong :focus-visible indicator, allow zoom, and provide caption/subtitle tracks or an equivalent transcript for videos.

findings.summary: Important browser-enforced security policies are missing and one cookie is not Secure.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. Cookie evidence found the first-party rp cookie lacking Secure and seven cookies using SameSite=None; HSTS and X-Frame-Options were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP in report-only then enforcement, add nosniff, a strict referrer policy and least-privilege permissions policy, and mark rp Secure with the narrowest workable SameSite policy.

findings.summary: A first visit contacts a broad advertising and tracking footprint before the user reaches content.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence observed 12 third-party origins including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick. HAR attributed 99 requests and 2,032,739 bytes to third parties, including 31 requests and 976,157 bytes to trafficjunky.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not load advertising/analytics until the matching consent exists, minimize vendors and event volume, batch analytics, and proxy or self-host essential assets where practical.

findings.summary: Public pages provide contradictory or missing indexing and sharing signals.
findings.evidence: The page has no meta description and declares noindex,nofollow; /robots.txt redirects to HTML (Lighthouse reports 4,069 parse errors), /sitemap.xml returns 404, multiple links use javascript:void(0), and discoverability coverage is 30%. The representative detail page has no JSON-LD or Open Graph metadata and canonicalizes to the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid robots.txt and sitemap, give each indexable route a unique title/description/canonical, use real href links, render core metadata/content server-side, and add accurate VideoObject/Open Graph metadata.

findings.summary: Two custom full-screen interruptions are stacked on first visit and the age modal is not a native dialog.
findings.evidence: The desktop screenshot shows the mandatory age gate while DOM evidence also exposes a full cookie overlay. The platform probe found one role=dialog but zero dialog, popover or details elements; cookie controls are assembled with custom div/button scripting.
findings.suggestedFix: Sequence consent and age verification instead of stacking them, use a native dialog for the mandatory modal, preserve focus/return focus, and keep equal access to essential-only consent.

findings.summary: The UI is hard-coded dark rather than participating in the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Normal and prefers-color-scheme:dark captures are identical, computed color-scheme is normal, and DOM/CSS inspection found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens with light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme query while preserving the established dark default if desired.

findings.summary: Route/state changes and navigation cues use abrupt legacy behavior rather than declarative transitions.
findings.evidence: The platform/CSS probe found no View Transition rules, scroll timelines or scroll-state/container behavior. Clicking the age action navigated the inspected target; route changes have no transition or attention cue in the captured first-visit flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add reduced-motion-safe same/cross-document View Transitions for age-gate dismissal and route changes, and provide visible current-location/attention cues.

findings.summary: Reusable surfaces rely on global media queries and fixed dimensions rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The CSS/platform probes found no @container use; DOM computed styles show fixed 780px html/body sizing while the 360px screenshot clips the gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Give independently reused cards, header controls and modal content containment and size-aware @container rules, with intrinsic widths as the baseline.

findings.summary: The page emits runtime errors, deprecated API warnings and blocks BFCache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded a SyntaxError, a null addEventListener TypeError, two deprecated API warnings and four BFCache failure reasons including an unload handler.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the parse/null-reference errors, remove unload listeners, replace deprecated media styling, and eliminate avoidable no-store/BFCache blockers.

findings.summary: The first-visit resource and media budget is disproportionate to an age-gate view.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 5.4MB before content access, including 2.03MB third party. Image evidence found 33 of 37 images without srcset, 24 legacy-format images, three without dimensions and two below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not fetch the underlying feed/ads before age confirmation, deliver responsive AVIF/WebP sources with dimensions, lazy-load below-fold media, and enforce a first-gate byte budget.

findings.summary: The Dutch locale mixes substantial untranslated English UI and content.
findings.evidence: html lang is nl, but the first-visit cookie controls are English (Accept All Cookies, Accept Only Essential Cookies, Customize Cookies), several visible content titles remain English, and no dir attribute is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Localize every first-visit control/content label consistently, set explicit direction where needed, and use logical CSS properties so translated text can expand safely.

findings.summary: Unknown routes silently return the homepage with HTTP 200 instead of a recoverable not-found state.
findings.evidence: A request to a deliberately nonexistent route followed redirects and ended at https://nl.pornhub.com/ with HTTP 200 and homepage HTML. /robots.txt follows the same behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an actual 404 for unknown resources/routes and render a focused recovery page with search, home navigation and retry guidance.

findings.summary: The primary search field is unlabeled and explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.evidence: The listing/home probe found a text input named search with no associated label and autocomplete=off; Lighthouse also found accessible-name mismatches.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a persistent or accessible label, a descriptive search autocomplete token/behavior, and keep browser input assistance enabled unless there is a documented necessity.

taskList.title: Fix mobile gate reflow, semantic modal focus and zoom/accessibility
Stop preloading the feed/ads and repair LCP, CLS and bundle delivery
Deploy missing security policies and harden cookies
Repair robots, metadata, canonicals and server-rendered discoverability
Resolve console errors, deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers
Complete Dutch localization and input assistance
Add preference-aware theme and modern navigation transitions
Return real, recoverable HTTP error states
